description: Returns one move or word. A Do list move (by id c4c:beh:wave_hello, short name or page slug): its block program as JSON and screenplay text, the motion language's lines that play it, its length, settings, page and links. A motion language word (people.sneak, or sneak): its form, dials, bodies and whole text. Example: {"move": "wave_hello"}.

move.description: Its id, short name or page slug, as list_moves gives them.

name: get_move
title: Get one move's program and readable text
